exposure: preoperative cystoscopy findings (bulging, mucosal hyperemia, mucosal hyperemia around ureteral orifices, bridging blood vessels with and without arterial pulsation, distortion of trigone)
cohort: The study included 66 patients with suspected Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) who underwent cystoscopy with ureteral stent placement at the time of cesarean hysterectomy at a tertiary care center from 2018 to 2024.
finding: The presence of bridging blood vessels on the lower posterior wall of the bladder during preoperative cystoscopy was significantly associated with severe blood loss of over two liters.
